build_COCOCaptionMetric: build a COCOCaptionMetric instance with an annotation file path for COCO caption evaluation
process_COCOCaptionMetric: process a batch of data samples to extract captions and image IDs for evaluation
save_result: save caption prediction results as a JSON file with optional duplicate removal by image ID
coco_caption_eval: evaluate caption predictions against ground truth annotations using COCOEvalCap and return metric scores
compute_metrics_COCOCaptionMetric: compute caption evaluation metrics from processed results by saving predictions and running COCO evaluation
